'''Plague Bearer''' is a [[chaos]] [[spell]] [[active skill gem|skill]] that grants the user a buff that can be toggled between Incubating or Infecting. While Incubating, the buff causes the user to deal less [[poison]] damage, and charges Plague Value based on inflicted poisons. While Infecting, the buff depletes its Plague Value to deal chaos [[damage over time]] to nearby enemies. 

==Skill functions and interactions==
The gem's advanced description specifies ''{{c|help|(The Expected Damage of Poison is its Damage per second multiplied by its Duration)}}.'' This is based on the poison's base DPS and duration, and is not affected by the defender's stats such as resistances. Poisoning through {{il|The Golden Rule}}'s [[reflect|reflection]] also charges Plague Bearer, effectively doubling Plague Value gain. 

Plague Bearer inflicts its Infecting debuff in an area around the player, similar to {{il|Righteous Fire}}. This damage cannot be further scaled by the user's offensive stats. Its damage is mitigated normally by the enemy through e.g. [[resistance]] and [[damage taken]] modifiers (including Delirium<ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JFCip-bdWyg</ref><ref>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u4t0ISHeL1Q</ref>), and accordingly can be scaled through debuffs like {{il|Despair}}, {{stl|Shock}}, or {{stl|Withered}}. Its damage is not considered poison. 

By default, the Plaguebearer Infecting stage lasts 8.33 seconds (12%/second). With 20% quality, it instead lasts 6.25 seconds (16%/second). Combined with the legacy Eternal Labyrinth helmet enchantment, it lasts 4.76 seconds (21%/second).

Since the damage from Plague Bearer can't be directly increased, increasing its gem level or quality becomes the only ways to increase its base DPS (gem level increases the maximum plague value stored, while gem quality increases the rate the plague value is released). {{il|Empower Support}}, {{il|Enhance Support}}, {{il|Increased Area of Effect Support}} are the highest-priority support gems for Plague Bearer. 

Plague Bearer cannot currently be [[trigger]]ed, except by {{il|Automation}}.

}}

* Anomalous Plague Bearer now causes you to have 0.25% increased movement speed while Infecting per 1% gem quality (from 0.5% per 1% gem quality).
